label: Peak temperature of a stack
subgoals: Sum the stack power through the sink resistance
Add the far die's power times the bond resistance
Report the hotter die as the peak

label: Ordering dies in the stack
subgoals: Compute the peak for each die order
Subtract the better peak from the worse
Weigh the thermal order against the electrical one

subgoals: Write each temperature with self and mutual terms
Evaluate the peak for each placement
Subtract to get the gain from spreading
